goal: Tenant administrators manage multiple encrypted Kuaidi100 credentials and each Delivery keeps a stable usable credential assignment.
non_goals: Do not configure production credentials, deploy, or call the real Provider.
Do not implement automatic quota failover or duplicate existing Provider infrastructure.
expected_evidence: Stable credential selection and unusable-credential fallback tests
Masked multi-credential operations API and UI tests
Fresh and legacy-upgrade MySQL migration evidence
unsafe_assumptions: Do not assume one tenant has only one credential.
Do not assume a bound credential remains enabled or exists forever.
Do not assume a credential ID is safe without a tenant-scoped lookup.
stop_condition: Stop if credentials leak, tenant scope is bypassed, or Provider execution changes transaction boundaries.
